summary: Iteration 10 — Full E2E validation of the QRU Media Manufacturing Engine™: backend (video + meditation manufacture, verified guard, QC gate, publish gate + unknown-destination guard) + frontend Media Studio flow (KR select, video/meditation toggle, Manufacture Media trigger → library growth → detail render → Treasure Standard™ QC certification badge → publish destinations unlock and publish). All 7 backend tests pass. Consumer/learner lock and regression on admin pages (Command Center, Manufacturing Studio, Design Intelligence, Memory Engineering) confirmed.

issues: Pre-existing hydration warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' caused by ve-dynamic tracker spans injected inside <option>. Cosmetic; does not affect functionality (already noted in iteration 9).

critical_code_review_comments: media_engine.manufacture_media_job and media_qc_job both run as unbounded asyncio.create_task; if backend restarts mid-job the media_asset stays in 'manufacturing' or qc.status='running' forever. Same pattern noted in earlier iterations — consider a status-timeout reaper.

MediaStudio.js manufacture() setInterval poll cleared only when no media has status='manufacturing'. If a second background manufacture (e.g. from another admin session) is running when the current user's job finishes, the poll keeps refetching library every 4s until all globally 'manufacturing' items settle. Minor UX; consider polling only on the mid you just started.

media.py library endpoint strips assets (projection {'assets': 0}) — good for payload size — but that means the initial /media/library response omits legacy_learners etc.; the detail GET /api/media/{mid} correctly returns them. Behavior is intentional, just note for future consumers.

publish endpoint returns 400 for both 'not-certified' and 'unknown destination'. Two distinct error paths share the same status code; consider 409 (or 422) for policy-block vs 400 for validation to help clients differentiate.

success_rate.backend: 100% (7/7 passed — 1 previously-skipped guard test also verified once /api/knowledge-records was queried correctly)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (media studio manufacture, detail, QC-certified badge, gated publish unlock + publish click all verified; regression on 4 admin pages + learner lock all pass)

seed_data_creation: Manufactured 1 fresh video and 2 fresh meditation media assets for KR-DEMO-003 during testing; ran Treasure Standard™ QC on the fresh video (certified, publishing_ready=true) and published to YouTube (backend test) + Website (UI test). Existing library therefore contains multiple video + meditation packages for KR-DEMO-003 (How Insulin Controls Blood Sugar).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Media Manufacturing Engine backend routes live under /api/media/{manufacture,library,{mid},{mid}/quality-control,{mid}/publish}. /api/media/library omits assets by projection (fetch /api/media/{mid} for full assets incl. legacy_learners & video/meditation sub-package). QC threshold is 75; deterministic scores for Production Completeness (based on presence of core assets) and Character Consistency (presence of character_dialogue) are computed server-side alongside AI scores. Publish accepts any destination in PUBLISHING_DESTINATIONS list (8) — connectors are STUBS that only record a publications[] entry (no real external upload). MediaStudio.js testids: nav-media, media-kr-select, media-type-video, media-type-meditation, media-manufacture, media-library, media-item-<id>, media-detail, media-qc, media-certified, publish-destinations, publish-<Destination>. Verified-KR list is fetched via /api/memory/records (module already exposes only Verified). Non-verified KRs are found by GET /api/knowledge-records?status=Draft (router prefix is /api/knowledge-records, not /api/knowledge).
